requirements.AL01: Replace the understated first collection with 18 individually generated full-colour illustrated artworks, three per car.
requirements.AL02: Six artistic identities: woodland engraving, pop art, industrial surrealism, porcelain/ink/glass, ocean myth and dramatic tattoo illustration.
requirements.AL03: Actual model fitting: upright bonnet heroes, side murals, roof supporting art, Kart pod charts, unpainted glazing and faded art boundaries.
requirements.AL04: Original image provenance, native stock comparisons, wash/restoration/cache controls, both desktop renderers and exact source checkpoint.
